Level1.Name: EnableMulticast
Level1.Description: Disable LLMNR (Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution) to prevent Responder poisoning.

Level1.Name: UseLogonCredential
Level1.Description: Disable WDigest authentication to prevent plaintext credentials from being stored in memory.

Level1.Name: EnableLUA
Level1.Description: Ensure User Account Control (UAC) is enabled.

Level2.Name: RunAsPPL
Level2.Description: Enable LSASS protection (RunAsPPL) to prevent memory dumping by non-protected processes.

Level2.Name: SMB1
Level2.Description: Disable SMBv1 protocol to prevent exploitation of legacy vulnerabilities (e.g., EternalBlue).

Level2.Name: NC_AllowNetBridge_NLA
Level2.Description: Prohibit installation and configuration of Network Bridge on your DNS domain network.

Level3.Name: UserAuthentication
Level3.Description: Require Network Level Authentication (NLA) for RDP connections.

Level3.Name: EnableScriptBlockLogging
Level3.Description: Enable PowerShell Script Block Logging for deep visibility into obfuscated scripts.

Level3.Name: AlwaysInstallElevated
Level3.Description: Prevent users from installing MSI packages with elevated privileges (Privilege Escalation mitigation).
